intent: Dropbox share links become direct dl.dropboxusercontent.com file links in the shared video parser; hexagon scroll mask panels with a playable data-video-link settle the whole frame so the injected video moves with the image.

findings.title: Settle target can be the whole panel when data-video-link sits on the item or a wrapper holding the panel content
findings.suggested_fix: Only settle the frame when it is not the item and does not contain [data-scroll-enlarge-snap-content]; otherwise fall back to the image.
findings.first_evidence: src/utils/scrollEnlargeSnap.ts:440 -- return frame && item.contains(frame) && hasVideoLink(frame) ? frame : image
findings.why_it_matters: item.contains(item) is true, so a frame attribute placed on the panel or a content wrapper scales headings and buttons from 1.2 with the image. Docs say to use the image's parent but nothing enforces it.
evidence: Node.contains returns true for the node itself

actionable_findings.title: Settle target can be the whole panel when data-video-link sits on the item or a wrapper holding the panel content
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Only settle the frame when it is not the item and does not contain [data-scroll-enlarge-snap-content]; otherwise fall back to the image.

residual_risks: Dropbox folder links (/scl/fo/) and other non-file Dropbox URLs are treated as playable files; the frame settles as a whole with no playable video (adversarial).
mediaVideo covers using the frame's first img while the snap uses [data-scroll-enlarge-snap-image]; they can differ if a frame holds two images (adversarial).
testing_gaps: No visual test for reduced motion or for data-video-link on the item itself.
Fixture video file is a non-existent path; tests assert boxes only, not playback.
